title: Esports' Biggest Prize Ever Just Collapsed
hook: It was $40 million. Then Valve changed one thing.
source: Valve compendium/battle-pass disclosures and reporting by Tips.GG and GosuGamers for Dota 2 The International: 2015 $18.4M, 2018 $25.5M, 2019 $34.3M, 2021 $40.0M, 2022 $18.9M, 2023 $3.0M, 2024 $2.8M. Riot Games and tournament reporting for League of Legends Worlds: 2015 $2.13M, 2018 $6.45M, and about $2.2-2.3M in 2019-2024.
